description: Large marketing-data aggregators and search engines.

brokers.name: Google 'Results about you'
brokers.steps: Needs the person signed in to their Google account. Open it from the Google app or Google Search account menu, 'Results about you'. Do not guess a myaccount.google.com URL: /results-about-you is a 404.
brokers.notes: Highest-value item for most people: removes phone and home address from search results. Never sign in on the person's behalf.
